photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 14:15:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 352 s; on-screen clock 05/03/13 14:15:50, wanted 14:15:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT-13 122  14:15-14:23' on 2013-05-02 (`as run matrix!B113`), read as 2013-05-02 14:15. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-05-02 plus one day, 14:15: it was found 302 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (51) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('51, pots 0.5, 0.4, 0.35, 0.33, 0.32', `as run matrix!J113`).
